title: Rav Acha Saba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman says that he always discusses matters with Rav Ashi, as in Kiddushin 21a, Bava Kamma 36a and 106a, Zevachim 91a and Menachot 6a. He was the son of Rav Mari bar Isur, and he is mentioned with his brother Mar Zutra in Kiddushin 65b.

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Kiddushin 65b names Mar Zutra and Rav Ada Saba as sons of Rav Mari bar Isur. The brother clause belongs to the entry subject, not to his father. Hyman’s heading Acha differs from the named witness Ada; “always” is retained as Hyman’s assertion.
The cited discussions name Acha Saba speaking to Rav Ashi. The brother episode in the consulted Kiddushin 65b names Ada Saba. Hyman’s ‘always’ characterizes the discussions.
